mathematical_definition: sqrt(EWMA variance of ret1, span=100, ddof=1, computed via pandas s.ewm(span=100, min_periods=1, adjust=False).var(bias=False).clip(lower=0)) -- causal EWMA volatility (de Prado-style), applied at whatever bar frequency the input is sampled
numerical_stability_notes: Variance clipped at 0 before sqrt to guard against tiny negative floating-point noise
missing_value_policy: NaN for the first bar (ewm variance with ddof=1 needs >=2 observations), never zero-filled
